note: alerts = one entry per bet (game/market/side), used for the record; result W/L/P or null. all_alerts = every alert sent, newest first, repeats marked repeat=true (logged from Oct 21). units_flat = 1u risked at the first alert's price, after the book's fee on winnings (ProphetX 2%; price_after_fee). Edge, the -130 cap, best-book choice and CLV all use price_after_fee. fade_* (from Oct 26) = best retail price on the OTHER side at the mirrored number when the alert fired; fade_units = 1u on that side, after fees. close_value_pct = TRUE closing value (from Oct 25): expected profit per 1u of price_after_fee at Pinnacle's no-vig win chance from one final read just before start, at the play's own number; beat_true_close = close_value_pct > 0. The older beat_close/clv fields beat the close almost by construction (ignore). executable_book = the alert book or an 'also' book is Novig/Kalshi/ProphetX/Polymarket. pushed_to_phone/sent_to_phone = not muted (delivery to the phone is not confirmed).
